exercises.name: Deep Belly Breath
instructions: Sit or lie down in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose for 4 counts, letting your belly rise.
Hold for 2 counts.
Exhale slowly through your mouth for 6 counts.
Repeat for the full duration.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
instructions: Sit comfortably with your back straight.
Exhale completely to start.
Inhale through your nose for 4 counts.
Hold for 4 counts.
Exhale through your mouth for 4 counts.
Hold for 4 counts.
Repeat the cycle for the full duration.

exercises.name: 4-7-8 Breathing
instructions: Sit with your back straight. Place your tongue behind your upper front teeth.
Exhale completely through your mouth.
Inhale quietly through your nose for 4 counts.
Hold your breath for 7 counts.
Exhale completely through your mouth for 8 counts.
This completes one cycle. Repeat 3-4 times.

exercises.name: Alternate Nostril Breathing
instructions: Sit comfortably. Rest your left hand on your lap.
Bring your right hand to your face. Place your index and middle fingers on your forehead.
Close your right nostril with your thumb. Inhale slowly through the left nostril for 4 counts.
Close your left nostril with your ring finger. Open your right nostril and exhale for 4 counts.
Inhale through the right nostril for 4 counts.
Close the right nostril and exhale through the left for 4 counts.
This completes one cycle. Repeat for the full duration.

exercises.name: Pursed-Lip Breathing
instructions: Sit comfortably and relax your neck and shoulders.
Inhale slowly through your nose for 2 counts.
Pucker or 'purse' your lips as if you are going to whistle.
Exhale slowly through pursed lips for 4 counts.
Repeat for the full duration.

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Breath with Counting
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, one hand on your chest and one on your belly.
Inhale through your nose, counting to 4, keeping the chest hand still.
Feel only the belly hand rise as your diaphragm drops.
Exhale through pursed lips, counting to 6.
Repeat, gradually lengthening the count as it feels comfortable.

exercises.name: Coherent Breathing
instructions: Sit or lie down comfortably and relax your shoulders.
Inhale gently through your nose for a slow count of 5.
Without pausing, exhale gently through your nose for a slow count of 5.
Keep the breath smooth and even, about 6 breaths per minute.
Continue for the full duration.

exercises.name: Humming Bee Breath
instructions: Sit tall and close your eyes. Rest your index fingers gently on the cartilage of each ear.
Take a full breath in through your nose.
As you exhale, gently press the cartilage and hum steadily, feeling the vibration in your skull.
Keep lips closed but jaw relaxed throughout the hum.
Repeat for the full duration.

exercises.name: Lion's Breath
instructions: Kneel or sit tall and place your hands on your knees.
Inhale deeply through your nose.
Open your mouth wide, stick your tongue out toward your chin, and exhale forcefully with a 'ha' sound.
Relax your face and return to a neutral breath.
Repeat 5-6 times.

exercises.name: Eye Palming
instructions: Sit comfortably and rub your palms together briskly until they feel warm.
Close your eyes and cup a warm palm gently over each eye without pressing on the eyeballs.
Keep your fingers relaxed and breathe slowly, letting your eyes rest in the darkness.
Hold for the full duration, then slowly lower your hands and open your eyes.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck (Forward Head Reset)
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Gently draw your chin straight back, as if making a 'double chin'.
Keep your eyes level - don't look down.
Hold for 3-5 seconds, then release.
Repeat 10 times to reset a forward-head posture.
exercises.caution: Move gently and stop if you feel dizziness or sharp pain.

exercises.name: Seated Neck Rolls
instructions: Sit tall with shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
Slowly drop your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Roll your chin down toward your chest, then continue to the left ear.
Reverse direction after a few slow half-circles.
Avoid rolling the head all the way back; keep the motion in front.
exercises.caution: Skip or shorten the range if you have a neck injury, disc issue, or feel any pinching.

exercises.name: Neck Extension Stretch (Gentle Look-Up)
instructions: Sit or stand tall with a long spine.
Slowly tilt your head back to look toward the ceiling until you feel a gentle stretch under your chin and throat.
Hold for 10-15 seconds, breathing normally.
Return your head to neutral slowly.
Repeat 2-3 times.
exercises.caution: Move slowly, keep the stretch gentle, and stop immediately if you feel dizzy or lightheaded.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion Stretch (Chin-to-Chest)
instructions: Sit or stand tall.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest until you feel a stretch along the back of your neck.
For more stretch, rest your hands on the back of your head with light, gentle weight only.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Lift your head slowly back to neutral.
exercises.caution: Never bounce or pull forcefully; ease off if you feel numbness or tingling in the arms.

exercises.name: Seated Neck Rotation
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed and level.
Slowly turn your head to look over your right shoulder.
Hold for 10-15 seconds, feeling a gentle stretch through the neck.
Return to center and turn to look over your left shoulder.
Hold, then return to center.

exercises.name: Left Levator Scapulae Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and turn your head about 45 degrees to the right.
Tuck your chin slightly and look down toward your right armpit.
Rest your right hand on top of your head and let its light weight deepen the stretch along the left side of your neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without pulling hard.
Release slowly and return to neutral.
exercises.caution: Use only the light weight of your hand - never yank the head. Avoid with any neck injury.

exercises.name: Right Levator Scapulae Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and turn your head about 45 degrees to the left.
Tuck your chin slightly and look down toward your left armpit.
Rest your left hand on top of your head and let its light weight deepen the stretch along the right side of your neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without pulling hard.
Release slowly and return to neutral.
exercises.caution: Use only the light weight of your hand - never yank the head. Avoid with any neck injury.

exercises.name: Left Upper Trapezius Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and reach your left hand toward the floor or grasp under the chair for anchor.
Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, keeping your left shoulder pulled down.
For more depth, rest your right hand lightly on the left side of your head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along the left side of your neck and shoulder.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side another time.
exercises.caution: Keep the pull light and slow. Skip if you have a neck injury, recent whiplash, or numbness in the arms.

exercises.name: Right Upper Trapezius Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and reach your right hand toward the floor or grasp under the chair for anchor.
Gently tilt your left ear toward your left shoulder, keeping your right shoulder pulled down.
For more depth, rest your left hand lightly on the right side of your head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along the right side of your neck and shoulder.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side another time.
exercises.caution: Keep the pull light and slow. Skip if you have a neck injury, recent whiplash, or numbness in the arms.

exercises.name: Shoulder Roll
instructions: Sit or stand comfortably with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift both shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back and down in a slow circle, squeezing the shoulder blades together at the back.
Complete 5 backward rolls, then 5 forward rolls.

exercises.name: Left Cross-Body Rear Delt Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Bring your left arm straight across your chest at shoulder height.
Use your right forearm to gently press your left arm closer to your chest.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch in the back of your left shoulder.
Release and lower your arm slowly.
exercises.caution: Stop if you feel shoulder pinching. Avoid if you have a rotator-cuff injury.

exercises.name: Right Cross-Body Rear Delt Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Bring your right arm straight across your chest at shoulder height.
Use your left forearm to gently press your right arm closer to your chest.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch in the back of your right shoulder.
Release and lower your arm slowly.
exercises.caution: Stop if you feel shoulder pinching. Avoid if you have a rotator-cuff injury.

exercises.name: Doorway Shoulder & Chest Opener
instructions: Stand in a doorway and place your forearms on each side of the frame.
Position your elbows at shoulder height, bent at 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward and gently lean through the doorway.
Feel the stretch across your chest and the front of both shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then step back to release.
exercises.caution: Don't push into shoulder pain. Avoid if you have a shoulder injury or instability.

exercises.name: Left Thread the Needle
instructions: Start on hands and knees, wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Slide your left arm underneath your body, palm facing up, and lower your left shoulder and ear to the mat.
Keep your right hand planted for support, or extend it forward for a deeper twist.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing into your upper back.
Slowly unwind and return to hands and knees.

exercises.name: Right Thread the Needle
instructions: Start on hands and knees, wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Slide your right arm underneath your body, palm facing up, and lower your right shoulder and ear to the mat.
Keep your left hand planted for support, or extend it forward for a deeper twist.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing into your upper back.
Slowly unwind and return to hands and knees.

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch (Mid Chest)
instructions: Stand in a doorway with your forearms braced on the frame, elbows bent 90 degrees at shoulder height.
Step one foot forward through the doorway.
Keep your chest lifted and gently lean forward until you feel a stretch across the middle of your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Step back to release and repeat with the opposite foot forward.
exercises.caution: Don't push into shoulder pain. Avoid if you have a shoulder injury or instability.

exercises.name: High Doorway Chest Stretch (Upper Chest)
instructions: Stand in a doorway and raise your forearms onto the frame above head height, elbows bent 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward and lean gently through the doorway.
Feel the stretch shift higher, across the upper and outer chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Step back to release.
exercises.caution: Keep the lean gentle - this raised-arm position loads the shoulder more than the low variant.

exercises.name: Left Supine Chest Opener (Open Book)
instructions: Lie on your right side with knees bent toward your chest and arms stretched out in front at shoulder height, palms together.
Keeping your knees stacked and still, slowly open your left arm up and over toward the floor behind you, letting your gaze follow your hand.
Let your upper back and left chest rotate open toward the ceiling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing into the stretch.
Bring your arm back to the starting position and repeat as desired.

exercises.name: Right Supine Chest Opener (Open Book)
instructions: Lie on your left side with knees bent toward your chest and arms stretched out in front at shoulder height, palms together.
Keeping your knees stacked and still, slowly open your right arm up and over toward the floor behind you, letting your gaze follow your hand.
Let your upper back and right chest rotate open toward the ceiling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing into the stretch.
Bring your arm back to the starting position and repeat as desired.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch (Prone Press-Up)
instructions: Lie face down with hands planted under your shoulders and legs extended, tops of feet on the mat.
Press through your hands to lift your chest off the floor, keeping your hips down and elbows softly bent.
Lift only as high as feels comfortable in your lower back.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, breathing steadily.
Lower back down slowly to release.
exercises.caution: Stop if you feel sharp or radiating lower-back pain; keep hips grounded throughout.

exercises.name: Standing Back Extension
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your hands on your lower back for support.
Gently arch backward, leading with your chest and looking slightly upward.
Move only as far as feels comfortable - this is a small, controlled motion.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Return to standing tall and repeat 5-6 times.
exercises.caution: Keep the arch gentle and controlled. Avoid if you have osteoporosis or acute back pain.

exercises.name: Kneeling Abdominal Stretch (Camel-Lite)
instructions: Kneel upright with hips stacked over knees, hands resting on your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes gently and lift your chest, arching back only as far as feels easy.
Keep your neck long rather than dropping your head back heavily.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to upright kneeling slowly.
exercises.caution: Avoid if you have knee pain when kneeling, or lower-back or neck issues; keep the arch shallow.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Flow
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale: drop your belly, lift your chest and tailbone (Cow pose).
Exhale: round your spine toward the ceiling, tucking chin and pelvis (Cat pose).
Flow slowly between the two, following your breath.
Repeat 8-10 times.

exercises.name: Left Seated Spinal Twist
instructions: Sit cross-legged or on the edge of a chair with your spine tall.
Place your right hand behind you and your left hand on your right knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and gently twist to the right.
Hold for 20 seconds, keeping both sit bones grounded.
Unwind slowly back to center.

exercises.name: Right Seated Spinal Twist
instructions: Sit cross-legged or on the edge of a chair with your spine tall.
Place your left hand behind you and your right hand on your left knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and gently twist to the left.
Hold for 20 seconds, keeping both sit bones grounded.
Unwind slowly back to center.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your big toes touching and knees wide.
Sit back on your heels and lower your torso forward between your knees.
Extend your arms overhead on the floor, palms down.
Relax your forehead to the mat and let your lower back lengthen.
Hold and breathe deeply for the full duration.
exercises.caution: Skip if kneeling causes knee pain, or widen the knees to make room for the belly if needed.

exercises.name: Left Single-Leg Supine Knee-to-Chest
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Draw your left knee up toward your chest and clasp your hands behind the thigh or shin.
Keep your right foot flat and your lower back relaxed on the mat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing evenly.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.name: Right Single-Leg Supine Knee-to-Chest
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Draw your right knee up toward your chest and clasp your hands behind the thigh or shin.
Keep your left foot flat and your lower back relaxed on the mat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing evenly.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.name: Double Knee-to-Chest Release
instructions: Lie on your back and draw both knees up toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins and gently pull your knees closer.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the mat.
Rock gently side to side if it feels good, massaging the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe deeply.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Flatten your lower back into the mat by gently tilting your pelvis and engaging your abs.
Hold the flattened position for 5 seconds.
Release back to a neutral arch.
Repeat 10-12 times, moving slowly with your breath.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold
instructions: Sit on the floor with both legs extended in front of you.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and hinge forward from your hips.
Reach toward your feet, keeping your back as straight as comfortable rather than rounding hard.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, letting gravity deepen the stretch gradually.
Roll back up slowly to sitting.
exercises.caution: Keep a slight bend in the knees if your hamstrings or lower back are tight.

exercises.name: Happy Baby Pose
instructions: Lie on your back and draw both knees toward your chest.
Grab the outside edges of your feet with your hands, opening your knees toward your armpits.
Gently pull down on your feet while pressing your feet up into your hands.
Rock slowly side to side to massage the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe deeply.

exercises.name: Left Supine Spinal Twist (Windshield Wipers)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms out in a T-shape.
Keeping your shoulders grounded, let both knees fall gently to the right toward the floor.
Turn your head to look toward your left hand for a deeper spinal stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing into the low back and side body.
Bring your knees back to center to release.

exercises.name: Right Supine Spinal Twist (Windshield Wipers)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms out in a T-shape.
Keeping your shoulders grounded, let both knees fall gently to the left toward the floor.
Turn your head to look toward your right hand for a deeper spinal stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing into the low back and side body.
Bring your knees back to center to release.

exercises.name: Left Standing Side Reach
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise your left arm overhead and reach up and over to the right, keeping both feet grounded.
Feel the stretch along your left side body from hip to fingertips.
Hold for 15-20 seconds without collapsing forward.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Right Standing Side Reach
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise your right arm overhead and reach up and over to the left, keeping both feet grounded.
Feel the stretch along your right side body from hip to fingertips.
Hold for 15-20 seconds without collapsing forward.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Left Standing Side Bend
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, left hand resting on your left hip.
Slide your right hand down the outside of your right leg as you bend sideways to the right.
Keep your hips facing forward and avoid twisting.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch along your left side.
Return to upright slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Right Standing Side Bend
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, right hand resting on your right hip.
Slide your left hand down the outside of your left leg as you bend sideways to the left.
Keep your hips facing forward and avoid twisting.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch along your right side.
Return to upright slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Left Kneeling Lat Stretch (Hands on Chair)
instructions: Kneel in front of a sturdy chair seat and place both hands on it.
Walk your hands slightly to the right as you sit your hips back toward your heels.
Let your left armpit sink toward the floor, feeling a stretch along your left side and lat.
Hold for 20 seconds, breathing steadily.
Walk your hands back to center and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Kneeling Lat Stretch (Hands on Chair)
instructions: Kneel in front of a sturdy chair seat and place both hands on it.
Walk your hands slightly to the left as you sit your hips back toward your heels.
Let your right armpit sink toward the floor, feeling a stretch along your right side and lat.
Hold for 20 seconds, breathing steadily.
Walk your hands back to center and switch sides.

exercises.name: Left Wall Bicep Stretch
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall, an arm's length away.
Place your left palm flat on the wall behind you, fingers pointing back, arm straight.
Slowly rotate your torso away from the wall until you feel a stretch through the front of your left arm.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Rotate back to release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Keep the elbow straight but not locked hard, and stop if you feel elbow or shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Right Wall Bicep Stretch
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall, an arm's length away.
Place your right palm flat on the wall behind you, fingers pointing back, arm straight.
Slowly rotate your torso away from the wall until you feel a stretch through the front of your right arm.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Rotate back to release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Keep the elbow straight but not locked hard, and stop if you feel elbow or shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Left Doorway Bicep Stretch
instructions: Stand in a doorway and place your left palm on the frame at hip height, arm straight and fingers pointing back.
Step forward slightly with your right foot and turn your torso away from your left arm.
Feel the stretch along the front of your left upper arm and chest.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Step back to release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Doorway Bicep Stretch
instructions: Stand in a doorway and place your right palm on the frame at hip height, arm straight and fingers pointing back.
Step forward slightly with your left foot and turn your torso away from your right arm.
Feel the stretch along the front of your right upper arm and chest.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Step back to release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Clasped-Hands Behind-Back Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall and reach both arms behind your back.
Interlace your fingers with palms facing your body, arms as straight as comfortable.
Gently lift your clasped hands away from your lower back and roll your shoulders back.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch across the front of your arms and shoulders.
Release slowly.
exercises.caution: Skip or keep the lift small if you have shoulder impingement or limited shoulder mobility.

exercises.name: Left Overhead Triceps Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Raise your left arm overhead and bend the elbow, letting your left hand drop behind your head.
Use your right hand to gently press on your left elbow, deepening the stretch.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Overhead Triceps Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Raise your right arm overhead and bend the elbow, letting your right hand drop behind your head.
Use your left hand to gently press on your right elbow, deepening the stretch.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Left Cross-Body Elbow Pull
instructions: Stand or sit tall and bring your left arm across your chest, bent at the elbow.
Cup your left elbow with your right hand and gently pull it toward your right shoulder.
Keep your left shoulder relaxed away from your ear.
Hold for 20 seconds.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Cross-Body Elbow Pull
instructions: Stand or sit tall and bring your right arm across your chest, bent at the elbow.
Cup your right elbow with your left hand and gently pull it toward your left shoulder.
Keep your right shoulder relaxed away from your ear.
Hold for 20 seconds.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Left Towel-Assisted Triceps Stretch
instructions: Hold one end of a towel in your left hand and drape it over your left shoulder down your back.
Reach your right hand behind your lower back and grasp the bottom of the towel.
Gently walk your right hand up the towel to increase the stretch in your left triceps and shoulder.
Hold for 20 seconds without forcing the pull.
Release slowly and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Ease off if you feel shoulder pinching; a longer towel makes this gentler.

exercises.name: Right Towel-Assisted Triceps Stretch
instructions: Hold one end of a towel in your right hand and drape it over your right shoulder down your back.
Reach your left hand behind your lower back and grasp the bottom of the towel.
Gently walk your left hand up the towel to increase the stretch in your right triceps and shoulder.
Hold for 20 seconds without forcing the pull.
Release slowly and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Ease off if you feel shoulder pinching; a longer towel makes this gentler.

exercises.name: Left Wrist Flexor Stretch
instructions: Extend your left arm in front of you, palm facing up.
Use your right hand to gently pull your left fingers back toward you.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the inner forearm.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Wrist Flexor Stretch
instructions: Extend your right arm in front of you, palm facing up.
Use your left hand to gently pull your right fingers back toward you.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the inner forearm.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Left Wrist Extensor Stretch
instructions: Extend your left arm in front of you, palm facing down, fingers relaxed.
Use your right hand to gently press the back of your left hand downward, curling the fingers under.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the top of the forearm.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Wrist Extensor Stretch
instructions: Extend your right arm in front of you, palm facing down, fingers relaxed.
Use your left hand to gently press the back of your right hand downward, curling the fingers under.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the top of the forearm.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Reverse Prayer Stretch
instructions: Bring both hands behind your back, fingers pointing downward.
Rotate your wrists so your palms come together in a reverse prayer position, fingers pointing up your spine.
Gently lift your hands up your back as high as is comfortable.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch through both wrists and shoulders.
Release your hands and shake them out.
exercises.caution: Skip if this is uncomfortable on the wrists or shoulders; a partial version is fine.

exercises.name: Prayer Stretch (Palms Together, Lower)
instructions: Bring your palms together in front of your chest, fingers pointing up like a prayer position.
Keeping your palms pressed together, slowly lower your hands toward your waist.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the underside of both forearms and wrists.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Raise your hands back to chest height to release.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
instructions: Extend both arms in front of you with hands loosely balled into fists.
Slowly rotate your wrists in large circles, 10 times clockwise.
Reverse direction for 10 circles counter-clockwise.
Shake your hands out gently to finish.

exercises.name: Left Seated Figure-Four Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Cross your left ankle over your right knee, forming a figure 4, and flex your left foot.
Keeping your spine long, gently lean your torso forward until you feel a stretch in your left glute.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Keep the crossed ankle relaxed rather than pressing on the knee joint itself.

exercises.name: Right Seated Figure-Four Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee, forming a figure 4, and flex your right foot.
Keeping your spine long, gently lean your torso forward until you feel a stretch in your right glute.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Keep the crossed ankle relaxed rather than pressing on the knee joint itself.

exercises.name: Left Supine Figure-4 Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross your left ankle over your right knee.
Reach through and clasp your hands behind your right thigh, gently drawing both legs toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch deep in your left hip and glute.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Supine Figure-4 Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee.
Reach through and clasp your hands behind your left thigh, gently drawing both legs toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch deep in your right hip and glute.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Left Standing Figure-4 Stretch
instructions: Stand tall near a wall or chair for balance.
Cross your left ankle over your right knee.
Bend your standing right knee and hinge slightly forward at the hips, keeping your back flat.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch in your left outer hip and glute.
Lower your foot and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Hold onto a wall or chair for balance to avoid falling.

exercises.name: Right Standing Figure-4 Stretch
instructions: Stand tall near a wall or chair for balance.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee.
Bend your standing left knee and hinge slightly forward at the hips, keeping your back flat.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch in your right outer hip and glute.
Lower your foot and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Hold onto a wall or chair for balance to avoid falling.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (Right Leg Forward)
instructions: From hands and knees, bring your right knee forward behind your right wrist, shin angled toward the left.
Slide your left leg straight back behind you, hips squared to the front.
Walk your hands forward and lower your torso over your front shin as far as comfortable.
Hold for 30-45 seconds, feeling the stretch in the right glute and the front of the left hip.
Push back to hands and knees slowly to release.
exercises.caution: Go only as deep as your knees comfortably allow; avoid if you have knee pain or hip impingement.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (Left Leg Forward)
instructions: From hands and knees, bring your left knee forward behind your left wrist, shin angled toward the right.
Slide your right leg straight back behind you, hips squared to the front.
Walk your hands forward and lower your torso over your front shin as far as comfortable.
Hold for 30-45 seconds, feeling the stretch in the left glute and the front of the right hip.
Push back to hands and knees slowly to release.
exercises.caution: Go only as deep as your knees comfortably allow; avoid if you have knee pain or hip impingement.

exercises.name: Left Kneeling Hip-Flexor Lunge
instructions: Kneel on your left knee with your right foot planted forward, knee bent at 90 degrees.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and engage your glutes on the kneeling side.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch in the front of your left hip.
Keep your torso upright rather than leaning forward.
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides.
exercises.caution: Place padding under the kneeling knee if the floor is hard.

exercises.name: Right Kneeling Hip-Flexor Lunge
instructions: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot planted forward, knee bent at 90 degrees.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and engage your glutes on the kneeling side.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch in the front of your right hip.
Keep your torso upright rather than leaning forward.
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides.
exercises.caution: Place padding under the kneeling knee if the floor is hard.

exercises.name: Left Low Lunge (Anjaneyasana)
instructions: From a kneeling position, step your right foot forward into a deep lunge, right knee over the ankle.
Lower your left knee to the mat behind you and untuck the toes.
Raise your arms overhead and lean your hips gently forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch down the front of your left hip and thigh.
Step back to release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Low Lunge (Anjaneyasana)
instructions: From a kneeling position, step your left foot forward into a deep lunge, left knee over the ankle.
Lower your right knee to the mat behind you and untuck the toes.
Raise your arms overhead and lean your hips gently forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch down the front of your right hip and thigh.
Step back to release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Left Standing Hip-Flexor Stretch (Foot Elevated)
instructions: Stand facing away from a low step or sturdy chair seat.
Rest the top of your left foot on the step behind you, knee bent.
Keep your torso upright and gently tuck your pelvis, sinking your hips slightly forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch through the front of your left hip.
Step down and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Hold onto a wall for balance and keep the surface low and stable.

exercises.name: Right Standing Hip-Flexor Stretch (Foot Elevated)
instructions: Stand facing away from a low step or sturdy chair seat.
Rest the top of your right foot on the step behind you, knee bent.
Keep your torso upright and gently tuck your pelvis, sinking your hips slightly forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch through the front of your right hip.
Step down and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Hold onto a wall for balance and keep the surface low and stable.

exercises.name: Seated Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet pressed together, knees falling out to the sides.
Hold your ankles or feet and sit up tall through your spine.
Gently press your knees toward the floor with your forearms, or simply let gravity work.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Release your legs slowly.
exercises.caution: Avoid forcing the knees down; let the stretch build gradually.

exercises.name: Left Side Lunge (Groin Stretch)
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to the right, bending your right knee while keeping your left leg straight.
Keep your left foot flat and your chest lifted.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along your left inner thigh.
Push back to center and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Side Lunge (Groin Stretch)
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to the left, bending your left knee while keeping your right leg straight.
Keep your right foot flat and your chest lifted.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along your right inner thigh.
Push back to center and switch sides.

exercises.name: Frog Stretch (Kneeling Groin Stretch)
instructions: Kneel on the floor and widen your knees out to the sides as far as comfortable.
Turn your feet outward so the insides of your feet are in line with your knees.
Lower your forearms to the floor in front of you and gently rock your hips backward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping the sensation mild-to-moderate, never sharp.
Slowly bring your knees back together to release.
exercises.caution: This is a deep stretch - ease in gradually and stop if you feel groin or hip pinching.

exercises.name: Wide-Legged Forward Fold
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, toes turned slightly in.
Hinge forward at the hips, letting your hands or forearms rest on the floor or a block.
Keep a long spine rather than rounding your back sharply.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, letting your inner thighs and hamstrings release.
Walk your hands back and roll up slowly to stand.
exercises.caution: Bend your knees slightly if you feel strain in your lower back or hamstrings.

exercises.name: Left Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand tall on your right leg, holding a wall or chair for balance.
Bend your left knee and grasp your left ankle behind you.
Keep your knees close together and your hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along the front of your left thigh.
Release and switch legs.
exercises.caution: Hold something for balance and avoid pulling the foot toward the glute if it strains the knee.

exercises.name: Right Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand tall on your left leg, holding a wall or chair for balance.
Bend your right knee and grasp your right ankle behind you.
Keep your knees close together and your hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along the front of your right thigh.
Release and switch legs.
exercises.caution: Hold something for balance and avoid pulling the foot toward the glute if it strains the knee.

exercises.name: Left Kneeling Quad Stretch
instructions: Kneel on your left knee with your right foot planted forward.
Reach back with your left hand and gently draw your left foot toward your glute.
Keep your hips square and pressing gently forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch through the front of your left thigh and hip.
Release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Place padding under the kneeling knee and avoid forcing the heel down if your knee is sensitive.

exercises.name: Right Kneeling Quad Stretch
instructions: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot planted forward.
Reach back with your right hand and gently draw your right foot toward your glute.
Keep your hips square and pressing gently forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch through the front of your right thigh and hip.
Release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Place padding under the kneeling knee and avoid forcing the heel down if your knee is sensitive.

exercises.name: Left Side-Lying Quad Stretch
instructions: Lie on your right side with your legs stacked and your head resting on your right arm.
Bend your left knee and reach back with your left hand to grasp your left ankle.
Gently draw your heel toward your glute, keeping your knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and roll over to switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Side-Lying Quad Stretch
instructions: Lie on your left side with your legs stacked and your head resting on your left arm.
Bend your right knee and reach back with your right hand to grasp your right ankle.
Gently draw your heel toward your glute, keeping your knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and roll over to switch sides.

exercises.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back as flat as comfortable.
Reach your hands toward the floor, bending your knees slightly if needed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, letting your head and neck relax.
Slowly roll back up to standing, one vertebra at a time.
exercises.caution: Roll up slowly to avoid dizziness, and keep a soft bend in the knees if your back is sensitive.

exercises.name: Left Seated Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your left leg extended and your right foot drawn in toward your inner thigh.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then hinge forward from your hips over your left leg.
Reach toward your left foot, keeping your back long rather than rounding hard.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Sit back up and switch legs.

exercises.name: Right Seated Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your right leg extended and your left foot drawn in toward your inner thigh.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then hinge forward from your hips over your right leg.
Reach toward your right foot, keeping your back long rather than rounding hard.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Sit back up and switch legs.

exercises.name: Left Supine Hamstring Stretch with Towel
instructions: Lie on your back with your right knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Loop a towel or strap around the ball of your left foot and straighten your left leg toward the ceiling.
Gently pull the towel to draw your leg closer while keeping your lower back relaxed on the mat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Bend the knee to release and switch legs.

exercises.name: Right Supine Hamstring Stretch with Towel
instructions: Lie on your back with your left knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Loop a towel or strap around the ball of your right foot and straighten your right leg toward the ceiling.
Gently pull the towel to draw your leg closer while keeping your lower back relaxed on the mat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Bend the knee to release and switch legs.

exercises.name: Downward-Facing Dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs as much as comfortable, forming an inverted V shape.
Press your chest toward your thighs and let your heels reach toward the floor.
Pedal your feet gently to stretch each calf and hamstring in turn.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower your knees to release.
exercises.caution: Bend the knees generously if your hamstrings are tight - a flat back matters more than straight legs.

exercises.name: Legs Up the Wall
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall, then swing your legs up the wall as you lower your back to the floor.
Scoot your hips as close to the wall as comfortable, legs resting straight up.
Let your arms rest out to the sides, palms up, and relax your shoulders.
Breathe slowly and hold the full duration, letting your hamstrings and lower back release.
Bend your knees and roll to one side to come out slowly.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch at Wall (Straight-Knee)
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands flat against it at shoulder height.
Step your right foot back into a lunge, keeping the back knee straight and heel flat on the floor.
Lean toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the back of your right calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Wall Calf Stretch (Soleus)
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands flat against it.
Step your right foot back, closer than the straight-knee version, and bend both knees slightly, keeping the back heel down.
Lean gently into the wall, feeling the stretch lower in the calf near the Achilles.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Left Seated Calf Stretch with Towel
instructions: Sit on the floor with your left leg extended.
Loop a towel around the ball of your left foot and hold one end in each hand.
Keeping your knee straight, gently pull the towel to draw your toes back toward you.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch in your calf.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.name: Right Seated Calf Stretch with Towel
instructions: Sit on the floor with your right leg extended.
Loop a towel around the ball of your right foot and hold one end in each hand.
Keeping your knee straight, gently pull the towel to draw your toes back toward you.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch in your calf.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.name: Kneeling Tibialis Stretch
instructions: Kneel upright with the tops of your feet flat on the floor, toes pointing straight back.
Slowly sit back onto your heels, keeping your torso upright.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the front of both shins.
Lift your hips slightly to ease off if the stretch is too intense.
Come forward off your heels to release.
exercises.caution: Keep this gentle if you have ankle or knee sensitivity; reduce how far you sit back.

exercises.name: Left Standing Tibialis Stretch (Toe Point)
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance.
Slide your left foot slightly behind you and point your toes, pressing the top of your foot toward the floor.
Gently press down through the top of the foot to deepen the stretch along your shin.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Standing Tibialis Stretch (Toe Point)
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance.
Slide your right foot slightly behind you and point your toes, pressing the top of your foot toward the floor.
Gently press down through the top of the foot to deepen the stretch along your shin.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Shin & Ankle Mobiliser
instructions: Sit on a chair and lift your right foot slightly off the floor.
Trace the letters of the alphabet in the air with your big toe, moving only at the ankle.
Complete a few letters, then switch feet.
This mobilises the ankle and gently stretches the muscles along the shin.

exercises.name: Ankle Alphabet
instructions: Sit comfortably and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Slowly trace the letters of the alphabet in the air using your big toe as the pointer.
Move only at the ankle, keeping the motion slow and controlled.
Switch feet and repeat.

exercises.name: Wrist & Forearm Release
instructions: Extend your right arm in front of you and gently pull back on your fingers with your left hand to stretch the wrist and forearm.
Switch to stretch the fingers downward for the opposite side of the forearm.
Shake out your hands, then interlace your fingers and stretch your arms forward, turning palms away from you.
Repeat on the other arm.

exercises.name: Sun Salutation Warm-Up
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and hands at your heart.
Inhale, sweep your arms overhead and gently arch back.
Exhale, hinge at the hips and fold forward, reaching toward the floor.
Inhale halfway, lengthening your spine flat, hands on shins.
Exhale, fold again, then inhale to rise back up to standing with arms overhead.
Repeat the flow slowly 4-6 times, moving with your breath.
exercises.caution: Move slowly and keep knees soft throughout; skip deep folds if you have acute back pain.

exercises.name: Upper-Back Cat-Cow (Seated)
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with hands resting on your knees.
Inhale, arch your upper back, lift your chest, and let your gaze drift up.
Exhale, round your upper back, drop your chin toward your chest, and pull your knees together.
Flow slowly between the two positions, following your breath.
Repeat 8-10 times.

exercises.name: Reverse Prayer Shoulder Mobiliser
instructions: Stand or sit tall and roll both shoulders back and down.
Bring your arms behind you and try to press your palms together in reverse prayer, or hold opposite elbows if that's more comfortable.
Lift your chest gently as you hold the position.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, breathing steadily.
Release your arms and shake them out.
exercises.caution: Use the elbow-hold variation if the wrist position is uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Left Chin-to-Shoulder Diagonal Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and turn your chin diagonally down toward your right armpit, as if nodding 'yes' to your pocket.
Rest your right hand gently on top of your head for light overpressure.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the back-left of your neck.
Release slowly and return to neutral.
exercises.caution: Keep the pull light; skip if you have a neck injury or disc issue.

exercises.name: Right Chin-to-Shoulder Diagonal Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and turn your chin diagonally down toward your left armpit, as if nodding 'yes' to your pocket.
Rest your left hand gently on top of your head for light overpressure.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the back-right of your neck.
Release slowly and return to neutral.
exercises.caution: Keep the pull light; skip if you have a neck injury or disc issue.

exercises.name: Left Sleeper Stretch (Internal Rotation)
instructions: Lie on your left side with your left arm out in front, bent 90 degrees at the elbow, palm down.
Keeping your upper arm pinned to the mat, use your right hand to gently press your left forearm down toward the floor.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch in the back of your left shoulder.
Release slowly and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Press gently - this targets a sensitive area of the shoulder. Stop if you feel pinching.

exercises.name: Right Sleeper Stretch (Internal Rotation)
instructions: Lie on your right side with your right arm out in front, bent 90 degrees at the elbow, palm down.
Keeping your upper arm pinned to the mat, use your left hand to gently press your right forearm down toward the floor.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch in the back of your right shoulder.
Release slowly and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Press gently - this targets a sensitive area of the shoulder. Stop if you feel pinching.

exercises.name: Left Doorway External Rotation Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a doorframe and bend your left elbow 90 degrees, forearm against the frame, upper arm at your side.
Keeping your elbow pinned to your side, rotate your body away from the frame.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch in the front-outer left shoulder.
Rotate back to release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Doorway External Rotation Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a doorframe and bend your right elbow 90 degrees, forearm against the frame, upper arm at your side.
Keeping your elbow pinned to your side, rotate your body away from the frame.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, feeling the stretch in the front-outer right shoulder.
Rotate back to release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Left Overhead Shoulder Stretch with Strap
instructions: Hold a towel or strap overhead with both hands, wider than shoulder width.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lower the strap behind your head and toward your upper back.
Lead slightly with the left arm to bias the stretch toward the left shoulder.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then raise back overhead.
exercises.caution: Widen your grip on the strap if your shoulders feel tight or pinch.

exercises.name: Right Overhead Shoulder Stretch with Strap
instructions: Hold a towel or strap overhead with both hands, wider than shoulder width.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lower the strap behind your head and toward your upper back.
Lead slightly with the right arm to bias the stretch toward the right shoulder.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then raise back overhead.
exercises.caution: Widen your grip on the strap if your shoulders feel tight or pinch.

exercises.name: Left Wall Corner Pec Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall corner and place your left forearm on one wall, elbow at shoulder height.
Step forward with your right foot and rotate your chest away from the corner.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling a deep, focused stretch across the left chest.
Step back to release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Don't push into shoulder pain. Avoid if you have a shoulder injury or instability.

exercises.name: Right Wall Corner Pec Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall corner and place your right forearm on one wall, elbow at shoulder height.
Step forward with your left foot and rotate your chest away from the corner.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling a deep, focused stretch across the right chest.
Step back to release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Don't push into shoulder pain. Avoid if you have a shoulder injury or instability.

exercises.name: Sphinx Pose
instructions: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms, elbows under your shoulders.
Press your forearms into the mat and lift your chest, keeping your hips grounded.
Let your lower back lengthen rather than crunching.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Lower back down slowly to release.
exercises.caution: A gentler alternative to Cobra - stop if you feel sharp lower-back pain.

exercises.name: Standing Forward Fold (Ragdoll)
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips and fold forward, letting your head, neck, and arms hang heavy.
Hold opposite elbows and gently sway side to side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing into your lower back.
Bend your knees more and roll up slowly, stacking one vertebra at a time.
exercises.caution: Roll up slowly to avoid dizziness.

exercises.name: Left Standing Reach-Through Twist
instructions: Stand with feet wide, knees soft, arms out in a T-shape.
Rotate your torso to the left and reach your right arm across and down toward your left ankle.
Let your gaze follow your right hand as your torso twists.
Hold for 10-15 seconds, then return to center.
Repeat 3-4 times on this side before switching.

exercises.name: Right Standing Reach-Through Twist
instructions: Stand with feet wide, knees soft, arms out in a T-shape.
Rotate your torso to the right and reach your left arm across and down toward your right ankle.
Let your gaze follow your left hand as your torso twists.
Hold for 10-15 seconds, then return to center.
Repeat 3-4 times on this side before switching.

exercises.name: Left Overhead Reach Lat Stretch with Strap
instructions: Stand tall and hold a towel overhead with both hands, arms straight.
Reach up and over to the right, leading with your left hip staying grounded.
Feel the stretch travel down your left side and lat.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then return to center and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Overhead Reach Lat Stretch with Strap
instructions: Stand tall and hold a towel overhead with both hands, arms straight.
Reach up and over to the left, leading with your right hip staying grounded.
Feel the stretch travel down your right side and lat.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then return to center and switch sides.

exercises.name: Left Extended-Fingers Bicep Stretch
instructions: Extend your left arm out to the side at shoulder height, palm facing up, fingers spread.
Gently extend your wrist so your fingers point toward the floor behind you.
Turn your head away from your left arm to add a gentle stretch through the whole limb.
Hold for 15-20 seconds and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Extended-Fingers Bicep Stretch
instructions: Extend your right arm out to the side at shoulder height, palm facing up, fingers spread.
Gently extend your wrist so your fingers point toward the floor behind you.
Turn your head away from your right arm to add a gentle stretch through the whole limb.
Hold for 15-20 seconds and switch sides.

exercises.name: Left Behind-Head Strap-Assisted Triceps Stretch
instructions: Hold a towel in your left hand and raise it overhead, letting it drape down your back.
Reach your right hand up from below your back and grasp the towel's lower end.
Gently walk your hands toward each other to increase the stretch through the left triceps.
Hold for 15-20 seconds without forcing, then release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Ease off if you feel shoulder pinching.

exercises.name: Right Behind-Head Strap-Assisted Triceps Stretch
instructions: Hold a towel in your right hand and raise it overhead, letting it drape down your back.
Reach your left hand up from below your back and grasp the towel's lower end.
Gently walk your hands toward each other to increase the stretch through the right triceps.
Hold for 15-20 seconds without forcing, then release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Ease off if you feel shoulder pinching.

exercises.name: Prayer Push Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall and press both palms flat against it at chest height, fingers pointing down.
Keeping your palms flat, slowly lower your body slightly to increase the stretch under your forearms.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Release and shake your hands out.

exercises.name: Left Standing Crossed-Leg Fold
instructions: Stand tall and cross your left leg in front of your right, feet close together.
Slowly hinge forward at the hips, reaching your hands toward the floor.
Feel the stretch settle into your left outer hip and glute.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then uncross and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Keep a soft bend in the knees and hold a wall nearby if you feel unsteady.

exercises.name: Right Standing Crossed-Leg Fold
instructions: Stand tall and cross your right leg in front of your left, feet close together.
Slowly hinge forward at the hips, reaching your hands toward the floor.
Feel the stretch settle into your right outer hip and glute.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then uncross and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Keep a soft bend in the knees and hold a wall nearby if you feel unsteady.

exercises.name: Left Couch Stretch
instructions: Kneel in front of a couch or chair seat with your left shin resting up the front of it, toes pointing up.
Step your right foot forward into a lunge, keeping your torso upright.
Gently squeeze your left glute and press your hips forward until you feel a deep stretch down the front of your left hip and thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Come out slowly and switch sides.
exercises.caution: This is an advanced, deep stretch - build up gradually and avoid if you have knee pain.

exercises.name: Right Couch Stretch
instructions: Kneel in front of a couch or chair seat with your right shin resting up the front of it, toes pointing up.
Step your left foot forward into a lunge, keeping your torso upright.
Gently squeeze your right glute and press your hips forward until you feel a deep stretch down the front of your right hip and thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Come out slowly and switch sides.
exercises.caution: This is an advanced, deep stretch - build up gradually and avoid if you have knee pain.

exercises.name: Left Cossack Squat Stretch
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, toes turned slightly out.
Shift your weight into your left leg, bending the knee and sitting your hips back, keeping your right leg straight with the foot flat.
Keep your chest lifted and hold for a couple of seconds at the bottom.
Push back through your left leg to center and switch sides.
Repeat slowly for 4-6 controlled reps per side.
exercises.caution: Keep the movement controlled and shallow at first; skip if you have knee or groin pain.

exercises.name: Right Cossack Squat Stretch
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, toes turned slightly out.
Shift your weight into your right leg, bending the knee and sitting your hips back, keeping your left leg straight with the foot flat.
Keep your chest lifted and hold for a couple of seconds at the bottom.
Push back through your right leg to center and switch sides.
Repeat slowly for 4-6 controlled reps per side.
exercises.caution: Keep the movement controlled and shallow at first; skip if you have knee or groin pain.

exercises.name: Left Reclined Quad Stretch with Strap
instructions: Lie on your right side and loop a towel or strap around your left ankle.
Bend your left knee and use the strap to gently draw your heel toward your glute.
Keep your knees stacked and your hips stable.
Hold for 20 seconds, then release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Useful if you can't reach your ankle directly; never force the range.

exercises.name: Right Reclined Quad Stretch with Strap
instructions: Lie on your left side and loop a towel or strap around your right ankle.
Bend your right knee and use the strap to gently draw your heel toward your glute.
Keep your knees stacked and your hips stable.
Hold for 20 seconds, then release and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Useful if you can't reach your ankle directly; never force the range.

exercises.name: Left Doorframe Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back near a doorframe and extend your left leg up the frame, resting your heel on it.
Slide your hips closer to the frame until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Keep your right leg extended flat through the doorway.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Slide away from the frame to release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Doorframe Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back near a doorframe and extend your right leg up the frame, resting your heel on it.
Slide your hips closer to the frame until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Keep your left leg extended flat through the doorway.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Slide away from the frame to release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Runner's Calf Stretch (Staggered Stance)
instructions: Stand facing a wall in a staggered stance, right foot back, both heels flat.
Lean into the wall, bending the front knee while keeping the back leg straight, to stretch the right calf.
Hold for 20 seconds, then switch stance to stretch the left calf.
Repeat 2 rounds per side.

exercises.name: Left Toe Spread & Stretch
instructions: Sit comfortably and cross your left ankle over your right knee.
Use your fingers to gently spread your left toes apart one at a time.
Hold each toe for a couple of seconds, then gently flex and extend all toes together.
Switch feet and repeat.

exercises.name: Right Toe Spread & Stretch
instructions: Sit comfortably and cross your right ankle over your left knee.
Use your fingers to gently spread your right toes apart one at a time.
Hold each toe for a couple of seconds, then gently flex and extend all toes together.
Switch feet and repeat.

exercises.name: Left Finger Extension Stretch
instructions: Hold your left hand out in front of you, palm facing away.
Use your right hand to gently pull each finger back individually toward your wrist.
Hold each finger for 3-5 seconds.
Shake out your hand and switch sides.

exercises.name: Right Finger Extension Stretch
instructions: Hold your right hand out in front of you, palm facing away.
Use your left hand to gently pull each finger back individually toward your wrist.
Hold each finger for 3-5 seconds.
Shake out your hand and switch sides.

exercises.name: Equal Breathing (Sama Vritti)
instructions: Sit comfortably with a tall spine and relaxed shoulders.
Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4.
Exhale slowly through your nose for the same count of 4.
Keep the inhale and exhale perfectly balanced in length and smoothness.
Continue for the full duration, gradually increasing the count if it feels easy.

exercises.name: Ocean Breath (Ujjayi)
instructions: Sit tall and relax your jaw and shoulders.
Inhale through your nose while gently constricting the back of your throat, creating a soft ocean-like sound.
Exhale through your nose with the same gentle throat constriction, keeping the sound smooth and even.
Keep both the inhale and exhale slow, quiet, and audible only to you.
Continue for the full duration.

exercises.name: Physiological Sigh
instructions: Sit or lie down comfortably.
Take a deep inhale through your nose, then, without exhaling, sip in a second short extra inhale on top of it.
Let out a long, slow, audible sigh through your mouth, releasing all the air.
Pause briefly, then repeat 3-5 times to quickly calm your nervous system.

exercises.name: Left Half-Kneeling Rear-Foot Instep Stretch
instructions: Start in a half-kneeling lunge with your working-side leg back, its knee on the floor (use a cushion under the knee if needed).
Flatten the top of your back foot against the floor, toes pointing straight behind you, so your ankle is fully pointed.
Keeping your torso tall, gently sink your hips down and slightly forward over your front knee.
Hold, feeling the stretch travel up the front of your back shin, then rise and switch legs on another round.
exercises.caution: Use a folded towel under the back knee if the floor is hard, and ease off if you feel pinching at the front of the ankle rather than a stretch.

exercises.name: Right Half-Kneeling Rear-Foot Instep Stretch
instructions: Start in a half-kneeling lunge with your working-side leg back, its knee on the floor (use a cushion under the knee if needed).
Flatten the top of your back foot against the floor, toes pointing straight behind you, so your ankle is fully pointed.
Keeping your torso tall, gently sink your hips down and slightly forward over your front knee.
Hold, feeling the stretch travel up the front of your back shin, then rise and switch legs on another round.
exercises.caution: Use a folded towel under the back knee if the floor is hard, and ease off if you feel pinching at the front of the ankle rather than a stretch.

exercises.name: Left Seated Behind-Hip Bicep Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your left hand flat on the floor just behind your left hip, fingers pointing away from your body.
Keeping that elbow straight, slowly lean your torso slightly forward and away from the planted hand.
Hold, feeling a stretch through the front of your upper arm and wrist, then release slowly.

exercises.name: Right Seated Behind-Hip Bicep Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your right hand flat on the floor just behind your right hip, fingers pointing away from your body.
Keeping that elbow straight, slowly lean your torso slightly forward and away from the planted hand.
Hold, feeling a stretch through the front of your upper arm and wrist, then release slowly.

exercises.name: Left Wall-Assisted Overhead Triceps Stretch
instructions: Stand an arm's length in front of a wall, facing away from it.
Raise your left arm overhead and bend the elbow so your left palm drops down between your shoulder blades.
Reach back and rest your elbow lightly against the wall, using its gentle resistance to ease the elbow into a deeper bend.
Hold, feeling the stretch through the back of your upper arm, then lower slowly and switch sides on another round.

exercises.name: Right Wall-Assisted Overhead Triceps Stretch
instructions: Stand an arm's length in front of a wall, facing away from it.
Raise your right arm overhead and bend the elbow so your right palm drops down between your shoulder blades.
Reach back and rest your elbow lightly against the wall, using its gentle resistance to ease the elbow into a deeper bend.
Hold, feeling the stretch through the back of your upper arm, then lower slowly and switch sides on another round.

exercises.name: Left Step-Edge Calf Drop Stretch
instructions: Stand on the edge of a sturdy step or curb with the ball of your working foot on the edge and your heel hanging off, holding a railing or wall for balance.
Shift your weight onto your left leg, keeping the knee nearly straight.
Slowly let that heel drop down below the level of the step until you feel a stretch through your calf.
Hold gently, then rise back to the step edge and switch legs on another round.
exercises.caution: Hold a railing or wall the whole time and move slowly — don't bounce or drop suddenly. Skip this one if you have ankle instability or balance concerns.

exercises.name: Right Step-Edge Calf Drop Stretch
instructions: Stand on the edge of a sturdy step or curb with the ball of your working foot on the edge and your heel hanging off, holding a railing or wall for balance.
Shift your weight onto your right leg, keeping the knee nearly straight.
Slowly let that heel drop down below the level of the step until you feel a stretch through your calf.
Hold gently, then rise back to the step edge and switch legs on another round.
exercises.caution: Hold a railing or wall the whole time and move slowly — don't bounce or drop suddenly. Skip this one if you have ankle instability or balance concerns.

exercises.name: Left Scalene Neck Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand tall and place your left hand flat just below your left collarbone, pressing down gently to anchor your shoulder.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Rotate your chin slightly upward and toward the right side.
Hold, feeling a light stretch along the left side of your neck, then release the anchor hand and return to center.
exercises.caution: Keep the pull light and slow. Stop if you feel tingling, numbness, or sharp pain, which can signal nerve irritation rather than a muscle stretch.

exercises.name: Right Scalene Neck Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand tall and place your right hand flat just below your right collarbone, pressing down gently to anchor your shoulder.
Tilt your head to the left, bringing your left ear toward your left shoulder.
Rotate your chin slightly upward and toward the left side.
Hold, feeling a light stretch along the right side of your neck, then release the anchor hand and return to center.
exercises.caution: Keep the pull light and slow. Stop if you feel tingling, numbness, or sharp pain, which can signal nerve irritation rather than a muscle stretch.

exercises.name: Temporalis Release
instructions: Place two fingers on the soft spot at each temple.
Make slow, small circles with light, comfortable pressure.
Let your jaw relax and your teeth part slightly as you work.
Keep breathing slowly and evenly throughout.
Continue gently for the full duration, then rest.
exercises.caution: Use gentle pressure only. Skip if you have a headache disorder that worsens with touch or any scalp or skin condition.

exercises.name: Brow & Forehead Smoother
instructions: Rest the pads of your fingers flat across your forehead.
Glide them slowly outward from the centre toward the temples.
Use light, even pressure — smoothing, not pressing hard.
Let your brow relax down as you breathe out.
Repeat the slow glide for the full duration.
exercises.caution: Use light pressure only. Avoid if you have a skin condition or injury on the forehead.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Prayer Stretch
instructions: Bring your palms together in front of your chest in a prayer position, fingers pointing up.
Slowly lower your hands toward your waist while keeping your palms pressed together.
Stop once you feel a stretch along the inside of your forearms and wrists, keeping your elbows lifted and shoulders relaxed.
Hold, breathing evenly, then release.

exercises.name: Wrist Extensor Reverse-Prayer Stretch
instructions: Bring the backs of your hands together in front of your torso with your fingers pointing downward.
Press the backs of your hands together and slowly raise them toward your chest, keeping contact the whole way.
Stop once you feel a stretch along the top of your forearms and wrists.
Hold, breathing evenly, then release.

exercises.name: Left Plantar Fascia Stretch (Toe Raise)
instructions: Sit in a chair and cross your left ankle over your opposite knee.
Reach down and gently pull your left toes back toward your shin with your hand.
Hold, feeling a stretch along the sole and arch of your foot.
Release slowly, then repeat on the other side on another round.

exercises.name: Right Plantar Fascia Stretch (Toe Raise)
instructions: Sit in a chair and cross your right ankle over your opposite knee.
Reach down and gently pull your right toes back toward your shin with your hand.
Hold, feeling a stretch along the sole and arch of your foot.
Release slowly, then repeat on the other side on another round.

exercises.name: Left Standing Crescent Moon Side Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and raise both arms overhead, clasping your left wrist with your other hand.
Keeping your hips square and both feet grounded, gently lean your torso to the right.
Hold, feeling a long stretch down your left side from armpit to hip.
Return to center slowly and repeat on the other side on another round.

exercises.name: Right Standing Crescent Moon Side Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and raise both arms overhead, clasping your right wrist with your other hand.
Keeping your hips square and both feet grounded, gently lean your torso to the left.
Hold, feeling a long stretch down your right side from armpit to hip.
Return to center slowly and repeat on the other side on another round.

exercises.name: Left Cow-Face Arm Stretch
instructions: Reach your left arm straight overhead, then bend the elbow so your left palm drops down between your shoulder blades.
Reach your other arm down and behind your back, bending that elbow so the back of your hand rests against your lower back.
Try to walk your fingers toward each other behind your back, using a towel bridged between your hands if they don't meet.
Hold, feeling a stretch through the back of your left upper arm, shoulder, and upper back, then release and switch sides on another round.
exercises.caution: Ease off or skip if you have a shoulder injury — don't force the hands to meet, a towel gap is fine.

exercises.name: Right Cow-Face Arm Stretch
instructions: Reach your right arm straight overhead, then bend the elbow so your right palm drops down between your shoulder blades.
Reach your other arm down and behind your back, bending that elbow so the back of your hand rests against your lower back.
Try to walk your fingers toward each other behind your back, using a towel bridged between your hands if they don't meet.
Hold, feeling a stretch through the back of your right upper arm, shoulder, and upper back, then release and switch sides on another round.
exercises.caution: Ease off or skip if you have a shoulder injury — don't force the hands to meet, a towel gap is fine.

exercises.name: Suboccipital Release (Finger Press)
instructions: Sit or lie on your back and bring both hands behind your head.
Place your thumbs or fingertips into the small hollow at the base of your skull, on either side of your spine.
Apply gentle, steady pressure and slowly nod your chin down and up a few times under your fingers.
Hold the pressure and let the muscles at the base of your skull soften and release for the full duration.

exercises.name: Prone Neck Retraction
instructions: Lie face-down with your forehead resting on your stacked hands or a small towel.
Without lifting your head, glide your chin straight back, lengthening the back of your neck.
Hold the retracted position for a couple of seconds, feeling a gentle stretch, then release slightly.
Repeat the glide-and-release rhythm slowly for the full duration.

exercises.name: Left Isometric Neck Side Press
instructions: Sit or stand tall and place your left palm flat against the left side of your head, just above your ear.
Gently press your head into your hand while your hand resists, so your head doesn't actually move.
Hold the resisted press for a few seconds, breathing steadily, then ease off completely.
Repeat the press-and-release for the full duration, then switch sides on another round.
exercises.caution: Use only mild, steady pressure — this is a gentle isometric hold, not a maximal push.

exercises.name: Right Isometric Neck Side Press
instructions: Sit or stand tall and place your right palm flat against the right side of your head, just above your ear.
Gently press your head into your hand while your hand resists, so your head doesn't actually move.
Hold the resisted press for a few seconds, breathing steadily, then ease off completely.
Repeat the press-and-release for the full duration, then switch sides on another round.
exercises.caution: Use only mild, steady pressure — this is a gentle isometric hold, not a maximal push.

exercises.name: Standing Chest Expansion Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and clasp your hands behind your lower back.
Straighten your arms and gently lift your clasped hands away from your body.
Roll your shoulders back and down while lifting your chest toward the ceiling.
Hold, feeling the stretch open across your chest and shoulders, then release slowly.

exercises.name: Kneeling Chest Stretch on Chair
instructions: Kneel in front of a sturdy chair seat with your hips stacked over your knees.
Rest your forearms on the chair seat and walk your knees back slightly so your chest lowers toward the floor.
Let your chest sink between your arms while keeping your hips lifted, feeling the stretch across your chest and armpits.
Hold, breathing deeply into your ribcage, then press back up slowly.
exercises.caution: Skip if you have knee or shoulder pain that kneeling or overhead reaching aggravates.

exercises.name: Doorway Overhead Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand in a doorway and raise both forearms to the top corners of the frame, elbows bent near shoulder height.
Step one foot through the doorway and shift your weight forward slowly.
Keep your chest lifted and core braced as you feel the stretch across the upper chest.
Hold, then step back to release and reset your stance before repeating.
exercises.caution: Stop if you feel pinching in the front of the shoulder rather than a stretch in the chest.

exercises.name: Seated Thoracic Extension Over Chair Back
instructions: Sit toward the front edge of a sturdy chair with a low or mid-height backrest.
Place your hands behind your head and gently arch your upper back over the top of the chair back.
Let your chest open and your head tip back slightly, keeping your lower back neutral.
Hold for a few breaths, feeling the stretch across your chest and upper spine, then curl back up slowly.
exercises.caution: Move into the extension gradually and stop if you feel any sharp pain in your lower back.

exercises.name: Left Pigeon Pose Hip Stretch
instructions: From all fours, bring your left knee forward behind your left wrist and angle your left shin toward the right.
Slide your right leg straight back behind you, keeping your hips as square to the floor as possible.
Lower your hips toward the floor and walk your hands forward, folding over your front leg if it's comfortable.
Hold, breathing into the stretch through your left glute and the front of your right hip, then rise slowly and switch sides on another round.
exercises.caution: Skip or use a cushion under the front hip if you have knee pain — this is a deep hip-opener, not a beginner stretch.

exercises.name: Right Pigeon Pose Hip Stretch
instructions: From all fours, bring your right knee forward behind your right wrist and angle your right shin toward the left.
Slide your left leg straight back behind you, keeping your hips as square to the floor as possible.
Lower your hips toward the floor and walk your hands forward, folding over your front leg if it's comfortable.
Hold, breathing into the stretch through your right glute and the front of your left hip, then rise slowly and switch sides on another round.
exercises.caution: Skip or use a cushion under the front hip if you have knee pain — this is a deep hip-opener, not a beginner stretch.

exercises.name: Bridge Pose
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, close to your hips.
Press through your feet and lift your hips toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes as you rise.
Clasp your hands underneath you and roll your shoulders in to open your chest, or keep arms flat by your sides.
Hold, feeling the stretch across your hip flexors and chest, then lower your spine back down slowly, one vertebra at a time.
exercises.caution: Skip if you have neck or lower-back issues — keep the neck neutral and avoid turning your head while lifted.

exercises.name: Standing Split Prep Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall or sturdy chair for balance and hinge forward from your hips, hands on the support.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right leg straight up behind you as high as comfortably possible.
Keep both legs as straight as you can and square your hips toward the floor.
Hold, feeling the stretch through the standing leg's hamstring, then lower slowly and switch sides on another round.
exercises.caution: Only lift as high as you can while keeping the standing leg straight and controlled — use a wall for balance.

exercises.name: Extended Exhale Breathing
instructions: Sit or lie down in a comfortable position and relax your shoulders.
Inhale gently through your nose for 4 counts.
Exhale slowly through your nose or pursed lips for 8 counts, twice as long as your inhale.
Repeat for the full duration, letting your body settle deeper with each exhale.
